# Dockio

Dockio Technosolutions Private Limited is an enterprise AI implementation and systems-integration company based in Mumbai, India. Dockio is an OpenAI Select Partner.

## Positioning
Make AI work. In your business. Dockio helps banks and enterprise teams turn OpenAI investment into working capabilities, meaningful adoption and evidence of value.

## Engagements
- AI opportunity and investment assessment: prioritised use cases, value hypothesis, feasibility, dependencies and a scoped implementation proposal.
- Embedded AI implementation: work alongside enterprise platform and business teams to deliver a defined workflow, agreed controls, evaluation and operating handoff.
- Adoption and value realisation: identify adoption friction, improve execution and link operational outcomes to validated financial impact.
- AI Implementation and Value Sprint: a scoped paid engagement for one workflow, with timing, dependencies and acceptance criteria agreed before delivery.

## Industries
Banking and financial services, including enterprise AI platforms and banking GCCs, is the primary focus. Other relevant engagements include private equity portfolio companies, enterprise operations and professional services.

## OpenAI partnership
Dockio's organisational tier is Select. Descriptions of ChatGPT adoption, API integration and Codex enablement are service offerings, not claims to separate specialization badges. Dockio provides its own professional services; product subscriptions and usage terms are governed by the relevant OpenAI agreements.

## BudgetOps
BudgetOps is in development. Its direction is recommendation-first AI investment intelligence connecting initiatives, adoption, realised value and the next funding decision. Product/project managers prepare funding cases; Finance validates adoption and realised value; business sponsors prioritise justified investment and emerging AI opportunities. Product direction is not a claim that every feature is available today.

## Evidence and enquiries
Workflow examples are representative patterns, not customer case studies or achieved-result claims. No guaranteed delivery duration or ROI is promised. Meeting bookings use the existing Microsoft Bookings calendar. The website enquiry form prepares an email draft on the visitor's device; the visitor reviews and sends it. It does not store or submit enquiries automatically.
